subject: SOC2 architecture deep-dive — evidence & slot coordination
messages:
From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@brightsec.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@brightsec.com
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 architecture deep-dive request — encryption, SSO, audit logs

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. BrightSec is kicking off our SOC 2 readiness plan and we'd like a focused architecture deep-dive on how Redwood handles encryption (at-rest/key rotation), SSO integration/audit trails, and audit log retention — specifically the evidence we can expect to request during our audit window.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute session next week to go through technical owners, what evidence you can provide, and any gaps to flag? Prefer mornings PST.

Attaching a short maturity checklist from our auditor to help scope the conversation.

Best,
Jamie Torres
Senior Security Program Manager
BrightSec
Attachment: brightsec-soc2-maturity-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 architecture deep-dive request — encryption, SSO, audit logs

Hi Jamie — thanks for the note and the maturity checklist, that helps. We can run a targeted session that covers:
- Encryption (KMS integration, key rotation cadence, customer-managed KMS options)
- SSO and authentication flow (SAML/OIDC, token lifetimes, user provisioning)
- Audit logs (what we capture, retention options, export formats)
- SOC 2 artefacts we can provide and timelines for evidence pull

Proposed slots (60–75m, PDT):
- Wed 07/15 09:00–10:15
- Wed 07/15 11:00–12:15
- Thu 07/16 08:30–09:45

I'll attach our SOC2 evidence checklist and a one-pager on encryption key handling to this thread so you can pre-read. Who from your side will need the deep-dive — auditors, security ops, or engineering?

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF stub), encryption-key-rotation.png (diagram)

- Start with a 25–30m block on encryption and evidence pull (Irene + Marcus)
- Follow with 30–40m on SSO, token management, and audit exports (me + Marcus)

Attachments included here: audit-log-retention-policy.pdf (policy extract) and a small diagram showing where logs are exported to your S3 collector (audit-log-export-sample.json—metadata stub).

Quick answers to Jamie's pre-asks:
- Artifact names/paths: /redwood/logs/production/{service}/{YYYY}/{MM}/{DD}/audit.log (we'll provide a manifest CSV for your auditor)
- Retention SLA: default 90 days (configurable to 365 days on Dedicated/Private plans — note: additional charges may apply)

If you want the manifest and a sample export before the call I can drop them in the Drive link.

Thanks — Soojin
